## Outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the small spec.

## Related tickets

- Related: #ISSUE — explain the acceptance criteria completed or still outstanding.
- Add the intended Development link; a related mention is not an instruction to close.
  Keep development completion distinct from release completion.

## Verification

Record commands and actual results. Include desktop/mobile evidence for UI changes
and identify unverified paths. Read the latest issue comments before implementing.

## Preview

Preview URL and exact commit SHA (or explain why no preview is applicable).

## Boundaries

Record migrations, compatibility risks and remaining decisions. No production promotion.
